title: Provenance graph
about: The verified graph of one or more registries: fotons, files and claims, who signed what, lineage in both directions, facets by participant and type.

graph@1.answer: {records, keys, names, attested?, packages?} - verified here by the kernel wasm; packages = {keyid: {package, id, dir, key}} of admitted packages' build keys (cockpit v0.5.3 /data/packages.json): with key, re-checked here and shown as 'signed by admitted package X, signature checked (not a trust tier)', never as verified - or {graph, sketch?, derived?, contracted?} - a graph the host built and vouches for

files: for the records form, its own pinned runtime/wasm/ (manifest.json, the .wasm), fetched from the viewer's origin: the leaf CSP needs connect-src for that origin (tests/e2e/leaf-csp.mjs). The {graph} form needs no wasm.

focus.about: the node to centre on: a foton id or a file hash (sha256:…)

mode.about: neighbourhood, ancestors, descendants, both, lineage, impact

facets.about: what is shown; participant = keyid, type = node type (foton, entity, claim, …). Empty set = no filter

layout.about: a layout name of the active view

view.about: a view preset name, or a change to the current view (panel, actions, select.multi, …)

selection.about: the multi-selection of fotons; only with view select.multi on, refused otherwise

focus.about: a click on a node sets it

navigate.about: the reader walked to a node (value = node, with mode)

intents.open: {kind:'open', uri} or {kind:'open', file:{name, hash, role}, node} - an act: the host opens the file or link

handover.v3: a frame with no data address: kton:ready, then kton:request {cap: 'graph@1'} after the first kton:set (core/leaf.js pattern; tests/shell/leaf.html plays the host)
handover.static: ?union=<url>[,<url>…] with sibling keys.json and names.json, ?packages=<url> (admitted packages' build keys; beside cockpit show's /data/union.json it is found by itself), ?graph=<url>, ?select=<endpoint>: the open-web pages
